author: Verybadsorry
body:
Name: 7h1r733n and my alts that got banned
Reason Iwas banned: For ban evading using alt, you then ip banned this acc.
Why I should be unbanned: I have a lot of altd, and I lent some to my friend darkraiplayzz (that's his ign) and I went to look at what he did with my alts and I realised that they have been banned for ban evading. My alt was banned for ban evading after he got tempbanned for combat logging. During the time that my alt was banned, I was in a team speak room with the mod who banned them, zerkk in there was also rilosux, random_nub and lokigh. I was playing with all of them and we were all in the same game, therefore I couldn't have been using the alts as I was still playing with one of my alts. Lokigh can vouch and confirm that I was talking to him on TS during the time when the alts were banned. If you look at when my 7h account was last played youbwilll see it wasn't on the time of the bans, so I wasn't ban evading, the player who got my alts were.

Thank you for your time, the accounts that were banned was this one, lolitabr and theflyhalfboy.
